tasks.short: Consult end users about difficulty accessing electronic content.

steps.what: Consult with end users about the content access problem
Reproduce the failed retrieval with the user
Inspect the document's effective permissions and retrieval diagnostics
Explain the cause and the authorised next action
Write and check the consultation outcome note
Commit the accepted consultation note to the support ticket

tasks.design: First configure a native effective-permission and retrieval view in {DOCS}, using the identity directory in {OTHER} read-only. Keep consultation, reproduction and explanation human; the specialist writes and checks the actual outcome before a separate commit in {HELPDESK}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Diagnosing access can require navigating multiple permission and identity screens.
tasks.enabler_now: Native effective-permission diagnostics can consolidate the same authorised evidence.
tasks.still_hard: A request for access does not establish entitlement, and user confusion may differ from the technical fault.
tasks.human_edge: Understand what the user is trying to do and explain a restricted result without exposing content.
tasks.altitude: Less diagnostic navigation and note submission; no new permission-granting rights.

reach.task: Diagnose document access failures without changing permissions

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: a native effective-permission view can reduce cross-screen navigation without deciding access entitlement.

assumptions: Boundary is consultation and its support record. Permission changes, owner approval and external messages are separate; no saving or transfer is claimed from them. Shares are provisional.

s1/s2 retain capture of user_id, document_id, attempted_action, timestamp and error_text. Document administration supplies permissions and identity administration supplies group membership; s3 reads both with authorised scope and manually investigates missing evidence.
s3's 60% remaining includes reading and interpreting the consolidated view. Test native diagnostics before code; if that view is already used, there is no new navigation saving.

s5 captures cause, guidance, unresolved_issue and ticket_id and checks the finished note. a1 binds the note and ticket; edits revoke approval. Existing direct-save automation earns no additional saving.
research_questions: Does the consolidated view show inherited and explicit denials without exposing restricted document contents?

incremental.description: Maintain diagnostic links and check support-note routing

approvals.approved_version: s5 accepted access consultation note and support ticket identifier

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central saves 6 navigation and 5 commit hours minus 1 upkeep = 10. Low gets half the navigation benefit and keeps commit manual: 3 minus 1 = 2. Consultation and note writing retain full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Review content-management problems and current system constraints
Count recurring ticket categories and affected repositories
Choose feasible content-management improvements and their trade-offs
Draft recommendations for improving content management system capabilities

loop.input: Specialist's selected recommendations, actual issue counts and source feature descriptions
loop.output: Proposal explaining the chosen changes, evidence, caveats and acceptance conditions
loop.check: Specialist verifies recommendation meaning, count claims and feature limitations in s4; s5 checks the complete revised version
loop.stop: One draft and one revision, then manual writing; unavailable features remain unknown
loop.why_not_simpler: Test an options template first. Prose explaining specific trade-offs and qualifications remains beyond deterministic counts and field assembly.

steps.what: Approve the complete proposal and internal review audience
Submit the accepted proposal for internal prioritisation

tasks.design: Use native category reports in {HELPDESK} to quantify already-coded content issues, with source evidence retained in {DOCS}. People choose capability recommendations; bounded drafting explains those choices and a final human review gates the separate internal submission in {PROJECT}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Issue evidence and system constraints need to be connected to practical recommendations.
tasks.enabler_now: Native counts plus source-grounded drafting can reduce table preparation and rewriting.
tasks.still_hard: Feature suitability, adoption costs and information-governance trade-offs remain human decisions.
tasks.human_edge: Choose changes that address actual retrieval and governance problems rather than attractive feature lists.

ambition.what: Provide a capability proposal showing which recorded content problems each change addresses.

tasks.altitude: Less issue tallying and proposal rewriting; prioritisation authority remains with the service owner.

reach.task: Trace a content-system recommendation to user problems and acceptance criteria

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: category counts are deterministic, while choosing suitable capability improvements requires judgement.

assumptions: Boundary covers analysis, recommendations and internal submission, not purchasing or implementation. Shares are provisional; the automate prior is moderated because suitability judgement remains substantial.

Support agents already maintain ticket_id, category, repository_id and opened_date as part of unchanged ticket handling. s1 verifies those fields; missing categories are manually resolved in retained review, never treated as free model tags.

s3 records selected_change, supporting_issue_ids, constraint, caveat and acceptance_condition at full effort. Feature descriptions come from current licensed-system documentation reviewed by the specialist; unsupported availability remains unknown.

Test native reports and templates before custom code. Existing reporting runtime earns no labour saving. s4 retains all source verification and fallback; s5 approves only after the last prose revision.
a1 binds the completed proposal and internal audience; it grants no implementation or spending authority. Any change invalidates it.
unknowns: Actual licensed features and review process
research_questions: Can the draft preserve limitations and distinguish selected changes from rejected options?

already_counted.description: Read and correct generated recommendation prose in s4

incremental.description: Maintain issue field mappings and audit proposal fidelity

approvals.approved_version: s5 accepted complete capability proposal and internal review audience

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central saves 15 tallying + 10 writing + 5 submission hours minus 2 upkeep = 28. Low covers half the tallying/writing benefits and leaves submission manual: 7.5+5-2 = 10.5.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Use data-capture technology to import digitised documents into the document-management system.

steps.what: Inspect the digitised batch for completeness and usable images
Enter or verify destination, document identifiers and metadata
Stage document files and metadata through the capture import interface
Check staged files, field values, duplicate matches and access
Commit the accepted batch into the destination document repository
Reconcile the receipt with source counts and failed items

tasks.design: Test the native batch connector between the capture tool in {OTHER} and {DOCS} before building an importer. Keep source inspection, metadata capture and full staged review human; the separate commit accepts only the checked batch version, and the specialist reconciles the resulting receipt.
tasks.previous_blocker: Batch transfer and repository commit can require repeated per-file actions.
tasks.enabler_now: Native import manifests and staged batch review can replace repeated navigation.
tasks.still_hard: Bad scans, wrong filing metadata and duplicate documents require resolution.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise a missing page or wrong case attachment that an import success code misses.

ambition.what: Provide a batch receipt tracing each source document to its repository identifier or explicit failure.

tasks.altitude: Less per-file transfer work; record-quality and access decisions stay human.

reach.learn: Document identity, duplicates and restricted filing rules

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: staged document batch imports and explicit metadata mappings can run deterministically without an AI classifier.

assumptions: Boundary starts with already digitised files; physical scanning labour remains outside and unchanged. Shares are provisional manual import labour, excluding image processing runtime.

Source producer supplies batch_id, filename, file_hash, page_count and source_document_id. s1 manually checks completeness; missing metadata or poor images are resolved through retained inspection and exception allowance, never assumed correct.

s2 captures repository_id, document_type, business_reference, document_date and access_group against records-manager filing rules. No free OCR extraction or automatic classification is assumed; capture remains at 100%.
s3 only stages files in a private review area; no business record becomes active before s5. s4 approves exact file hashes, mapped metadata, duplicate decisions and access groups after staging.
Native connector/configuration precedes code. Changes void a1. Existing automated imports earn no labour saving; failed-item correction beyond retained reconciliation is in incremental work.
research_questions: Can retrying a partially failed batch avoid duplicates and preserve a complete source-to-record receipt?

already_counted.description: Validate batch mapping and access within s4

incremental.description: Maintain import mappings and handle exceptional failed-batch repairs

approvals.approved_version: s4 accepted staged batch hash, complete metadata and destination/access snapshot

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central saves 15 staging + 10 commit hours minus 1 upkeep = 24. Low batches half the staging but keeps commit manual: 7.5 minus 1 = 6.5. Metadata capture and reconciliation retain full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare document-system support instructions and user training materials.

steps.what: Define user tasks, training goals and supported system version
Walk through procedures and capture actions, outcomes and safe screenshots
Prepare support documentation and training materials for document-system users

loop.input: Verified ordered actions, expected outcomes, exceptions, screenshot references and learning objectives
loop.output: Support guide and practice exercise grounded in those exact procedures
loop.check: Specialist checks every instruction against captured actions within s3; s4 performs the actual walkthrough, checks comprehension, screenshots and exceptions after the final revision
loop.stop: One draft and one revision; missing procedure actions or failed walkthrough go to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Test native guide templates first. Explaining conditional actions and matching exercises to learning goals needs prose; a list of screen names cannot supply the procedure.

steps.what: Validate the complete instructions and approve the final training package
Publish the accepted training package in the internal knowledge area

tasks.design: Use native guide and learning templates in {DOCS} and {LMS} first. A bounded drafting step turns the specialist's actual walkthrough evidence into instructions and exercises; a complete procedure test and meaning check follows the last revision before a separate internal publication gate.
tasks.previous_blocker: Useful instructions require actual procedures, not only release notes and screen titles.
tasks.enabler_now: Source-grounded drafting can reduce explanatory writing once actions and exceptions are captured.
tasks.still_hard: Incorrect instruction order or a hidden permission assumption can make a polished guide unusable.
tasks.human_edge: See where an end user will become confused and verify the real procedure works.

ambition.what: Provide a first-use practice exercise for staff who only occasionally retrieve documents.

tasks.altitude: Less guide drafting and publishing; procedure validation and training decisions remain human.

reach.task: Create a tested document-retrieval practice exercise
reach.learn: Learning objectives, accessible screenshots and procedure validation

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: bounded drafting can explain recorded procedures, but a walkthrough is required to verify instruction meaning and sequence.

assumptions: Boundary is material preparation and internal publication, not live training delivery. Shares are provisional, not derived from lesson-planning or developer benchmarks.

s2 captures procedure_id, system_version, role, precondition, ordered_action, expected_result, exception and screenshot_id in a test environment. All capture and sensitive-screen redaction remain full effort; missing actions trigger another manual walkthrough.
s3's retained 15 hours include prompt preparation, draft review, correction and fallback. Screenshots are the specialist's verified captures, never generated interface images.

s4 tests every procedure and exercise against the actual supported version after revisions, including permission and exception paths. a1 binds the complete package plus internal audience; edits revoke it.
Native templates precede custom code. Existing automatic publication earns no saving, and system-change maintenance is priced separately.
unknowns: Availability of safe test accounts and screenshots
research_questions: Can a representative user complete the documented procedure without an unstated prerequisite?

already_counted.description: Review and correct drafted instructions in s3
Post-draft procedure and exercise validation within s4

incremental.description: Retest guides after system changes and maintain source-to-guide links

approvals.approved_version: s4 accepted complete guide/exercise/screenshot package and internal publication audience

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central saves 15 writing + 10 publication hours minus 2 upkeep = 23. Low gets half the writing benefit and keeps publication manual: 7.5 minus 2 = 5.5. Capture and final walkthrough retain full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reduce repeated document transfer and drafting work while retaining information-governance, consultation and procedure checks.
reach: Help records managers specify reliable imports and IT trainers produce tested document-system exercises.
role.ambitious_version: A specialist who makes content easier to retrieve and training easier to follow with clear ownership of every record change.
